oi.text: Business segment operating income margin increased when compared to the same period last year. The increase was primarily driven by recognition of receivables for IEEPA tariff refunds and cost savings programs, including Transform for the Future benefits. These increases were partially offset by higher product costs due to tariffs and other inflation, including freight.

rd.heading: Research and Development
rd.text: R&D, measured as a percent of total net sales, decreased in both the second quarter and first six months of 2026 when compared to the same period last year. The decrease was driven by the impact of higher sales in advance of the ERP deployment and higher capitalized software development costs, partially offset by additional amortization expense from the acquisition of Acera.

ga.heading: Selling, General and Administrative
ga.text: SG&A, measured as a percent of total net sales, increased in both the second quarter and first six months of 2026 when compared to the same period last year. The increase was driven by accrued legal expenses, partially offset by insurance recoveries, and higher costs associated with activities to separate operations from 3M.

sga.heading: Selling, General and Administrative
sga.text: SG&A, measured as a percent of total net sales, increased in both the second quarter and first six months of 2026 when compared to the same period last year. The increase was driven by accrued legal expenses, partially offset by insurance recoveries, and higher costs associated with activities to separate operations from 3M.

nonop.text: Interest expense, net includes interest accrued on debt obligations, offset by interest income from cash and marketable securities. Interest expense, net decreased for both the three and six months ended June 30, 2026 as compared to the same period last year due to lower interest expense as a result of lower debt outstanding.

tax.text: Refer to Note 8 to the condensed consolidated financial statements for further discussion of income taxes.

ocf.heading: Operating Activities
ocf.text: In the first six months of 2026, cash flows provided by operating activities decreased compared to the first six months of 2025 primarily due to higher payments for annual incentive compensation and payments made in connection with the exit of certain transition agreements with 3M.

da.text: Cost of software and rentals includes compensation-related costs associated with installation, training and maintenance for our software products, and depreciation, maintenance and refurbishment costs and logistics costs related to our hardware rental units.

capex.text: Solventum's principal sources of liquidity are our existing cash and cash equivalents, cash generated from operations, and access to both our revolving credit facility and commercial paper program, which the Company believes will satisfy our foreseeable operating needs, capital expenditures, and debt service requirements. Discretionary cash may be allocated to strategic acquisitions, share repurchases, or repayment of debt obligations. The Company's cash position reflects business results and a global cash management strategy that leverages liquidity management along with analyzing economic factors and tax considerations.

net sales.heading: Net Sales
net sales.text: Refer to the preceding “ —Overview ” section and the “ —Performance by Business Segment ” section later in MD&A for discussion of sales change.

Product.heading: Cost of Product
Product.text:
Cost of product includes manufacturing, engineering and logistics costs. The Company operates a global supply chain and sourcing organization, including product sourced under master supply and transition manufacturing agreements with 3M. As a result, the Company is impacted by changes in the global regulatory and economic environment, including tariffs. The evolving regulatory and economic environment may impact our cost or ability to source products. To the extent possible the Company takes actions to offset these costs or identify alternative sources of supply.

Cost of product, measured as a percent of sales of product, decreased in both the second quarter and first six months of 2026 as compared to the same periods last year. The decrease was primarily driven by IEEPA tariff refunds and the benefit from programmatic savings programs, partially offset by inflation and tariff costs, which had minor impacts in both the second quarter and first six months of 2025.

Software and rentals.heading: Cost of Software and Rentals
Software and rentals.text:
Cost of software and rentals includes compensation-related costs associated with installation, training and maintenance for our software products, and depreciation, maintenance and refurbishment costs and logistics costs related to our hardware rental units.

Cost of software and rentals, measured as a percent of sales of software and rentals, decreased during both the second quarter and first six months of 2026 as compared to the same periods last year due to the impact, driven by benefits from both price and product mix.

intro.text: Solventum Corporation ("Solventum," "we," "our," "us," or the "Company"), is a leading global healthcare company developing, manufacturing, and commercializing a broad portfolio of solutions that leverages deep material science, data science, and digital capabilities to address critical customer and patient needs. We constantly seek to enable the improvement of standards of care and move healthcare forward with innovation powered by insights, clinical intelligence, technology, and manufacturing expertise. Our 70+ year history of discovering and innovating advanced solutions has helped us solve our customers’ toughest challenges.

lines.name: Cash and cash equivalents
lines.why: Cash can repay debt or be paid out: a financial asset. Cash needed to run the business is operating; move it if you know how much.

lines.name: Receivables
lines.why: Owed by customers for sales: operating.

lines.name: Inventory
lines.why: Goods held for sale: operating.

lines.name: Prepaid and other current assets
lines.why: Prepayments and other operating items: operating.

lines.name: Property, plant and equipment
lines.why: Assets used to produce and sell: operating.

lines.name: Operating lease right-of-use assets
lines.why: Leased stores, offices and equipment used in the business: operating.

lines.name: Goodwill
lines.why: Paid for acquired businesses: operating.

lines.name: Intangible assets
lines.why: Acquired technology, brands and customer relationships: operating.

lines.name: Deferred tax assets
lines.why: Taxes on operating income paid ahead: operating.

lines.name: Other non-current assets
lines.why: Other long-term operating items: operating.

lines.name: Accounts payable
lines.why: Owed to suppliers for operations: operating.

lines.name: Accrued liabilities
lines.why: Services and other costs not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Accrued compensation
lines.why: Wages, bonuses and benefits earned but not yet paid: operating.

lines.name: Deferred revenue
lines.why: Customers' payments ahead of delivery: operating.

lines.name: Income taxes payable
lines.why: Taxes on operating income: operating.

lines.name: Other current liabilities
lines.why: Other operating items due within a year: operating.

lines.name: Short-term debt and commercial paper
lines.why: Borrowed money: financial.

lines.name: Long-term debt
lines.why: Bonds, notes and loans: financial.

lines.name: Operating lease liabilities
lines.why: Rent owed on leases used in the business: operating by default. Move it to financing to treat leases like debt (if the balance sheet has no lease line of its own, they sit inside other liabilities).

lines.name: Deferred tax liabilities
lines.why: Taxes on operating income deferred: operating.

lines.name: Pension and retiree benefits
lines.why: Promised to employees for their work: operating (some analysts treat the unfunded part as debt).

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities
lines.why: Other long-term operating obligations: operating.

lines.name: Other current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current assets minus the current lines above: current assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current assets, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current assets (total assets − current assets) minus the non-current lines above: assets the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Total current liabilities minus the current lines above: current liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

lines.name: Other non-current liabilities, not tagged separately
lines.why: Non-current liabilities (total liabilities − current liabilities) minus the non-current lines above: liabilities the company tags its own way. Operating by default.

accounts.note: Acquisitions add goodwill and intangibles at their allocated values, not at the cash paid; the residual is the difference and the amortisation.

accounts.name: Equity
accounts.note: Other comprehensive income (currency translation, unrealised gains) moves equity without passing through net income: it is in the residual.
